To pursue its development, G Mining is looking for a dynamic and motivated individual to fill the position of:
Intermediate Architect
Summary Of Responsibilities
As a member of the CSA team, the architect will be responsible for the design and development of architectural work related to industrial buildings and infrastructure. This includes drafting, detailing and preparing construction documents in accordance with national and international codes and standards. The incumbent must coordinate with multiple disciplines and stakeholders to support design conception, procurement activities, CAPEX estimates and construction execution. The Architect will also play a key role in ensuring alignment between design and field activities to ensure project success. More specifically, the incumbent will:

  • Prepare drawings, specifications, scope of work and construction documentation.
  • Design and document industrial buildings according to local and international codes and regulations.
  • Develop and manage architecture budgets (CAPEX), contributing to cost analysis and procurement strategies.
  • Coordinate the selection and acquisition of architectural materials, including the review of supplier bids.
  • Consult with internal teams and clients to define design requirements.
  • Organize and manage design documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead or support architectural studies for new structures and site development.
  • Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams, including those working remotely.
  • Provide innovative and practical solutions to design and coordination problems.
  • Modify existing architectural designs to meet project specific site conditions.
  • Coordinate with project planners and controllers to ensure accurate progress reports.
  • Interface with various on-site stakeholders including craft teams, contractors, QC and designers.
  • Ensure construction activities comply with federal, state and local codes as well as internal standards and contractual obligations.
  • Provide field support and oversight of architectural works as required.
Health, Safety, And Environmental (HSE) Responsibilities
  • Demonstrate knowledge of applicable building, environmental and safety codes and standards.
  • Promote a strong culture of safety, quality and environmental compliance at all project sites.
  • During site visits or field rotations, ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including but not limited to steel-toed boots and long-sleeved shirts as per the Health and Safety Plan.
  • Maintain physical and mental readiness to work in challenging environments on site and for extended hours, without compromising safety.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in architecture.
  • Proven progressive experience in architectural design and construction of similar or large industrial installations.
  • Demonstrated experience working on active construction sites and with multi-disciplinary teams.
Additional Skills And Attributes
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, Access).
  • Advanced skills in AutoCAD, Revit and architectural visualization tools.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Advanced English.
Essential Skills
  • Team player with the ability to work independently.
  • Ability to work autonomously and independently, aligned with team and company objectives .
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a strong focus on problem solving.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • High level of commitment to safety, environmental responsibility and labour standards.
Additional Information
  • The position will be based at the G Mining Services office in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.
If you feel ready and willing to be part of a team of experienced professionals, involved in various areas of the mining industry and driven by the desire to succeed in the projects in which they are involved, we offer you a challenge that matches your ambitions.

G Mining cares strongly about the well-being of its employees so that they can thrive in all areas of their lives. The company’s family values are reflected across the range of benefits provided to our team members. By joining our team, you will get to enjoy the following benefits:

Estamos há mais de 20 anos no mercado automotivo!
A história do Grupo Carrera teve início em 2002, com a marca Chevrolet em São Paulo.
Em 2014, o grupo deu mais um passo em direção ao crescimento com a Volkswagen, abrindo lojas em Osasco e Alphaville.
Na sequência, em 2015, o grupo foi nomeado Concessionário Nissan, estabelecendo lojas em São Paulo, Vale do Paraíba e Interior.
Em 2019 uma nova nomeação Chevrolet, dessa vez em Brasília, com o desafio de ajudar no processo de recuperação do share da capital do País.
Em 2020, o Grupo Carrera deu um novo passo estratégico ao começar a atuar com a marca Renault, com lojas em São Paulo e Cotia.
De olho na nova perspectiva de veículos híbridos e elétricos, alinhando-se com as demandas crescentes por tecnologias mais sustentáveis, o grupo expande em 2022 com a marca GWM.
Já em 2023 o grupo incorpora a marca de motos Bajaj, fortalecendo sua presença em Brasília e ampliando seu portfólio de produtos para atender às necessidades dos consumidores de duas rodas.
Atualmente, temos mais de 30 lojas do grupo, localizadas na Grande São Paulo e Brasília.
E nosso grupo só cresce: Hoje estamos com 1500 colaboradores!
A matriz fica situada em São Paulo e conta com diversos departamentos internos inovadores, como T.I e Marketing, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade, Financeiro, Fiscal, Compras/Manutenção e soluções financeiras por meio do setor de F&I. Além disso, o grupo possui Seguradora e Blindadora própria.
Nosso PROPÓSITO é Facilitar o acesso das pessoas a produtos de mobilidade e serviços relacionados.
Missão: Viabilizar aos nossos clientes a melhor solução de mobilidade e serviços relacionados.
Visão: Ser reconhecido como um dos maiores grupos de soluções de mobilidade do Brasil, reconhecido pela ética e inovação na prestação de serviços e como referência em local para se trabalhar

• Cuidado com o colaborador

Job description

Quem somos?

A Companhia Riograndense de Saneamento foi fundada em 28 de março de 1966 tendo como objeto a realização de estudos, projetos, construções, operações, exploração e ampliação dos serviços públicos de abastecimento de água potável e de esgotamento sanitário no Rio Grande do Sul.

Atualmente, a Corsan atua em 317 municípios, atendendo cerca de 6,5 milhões de gaúchos, pouco mais da metade da população do Estado. Em leilão no dia 20 de dezembro de 2020 a estatal foi adquirida pela Aegea Saneamento, que assumiu a administração da Companhia em 7 de julho de 2023.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 154 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de 21 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.


Main responsibilities

  • Resolver problemas complexos, criar, inovar e modernizar processos; Orientar tecnicamente os seus pares; Analisar contratos ou demais termos de assunção de responsabilidades, a serem firmados pela empresa;
  • Emitir pareceres jurídicos solicitados pelas demais áreas da empresa; Organizar e controle os processos judiciais (sistema jurídico, arquivo físico e virtual); Analisar as correspondências expedidas pela empresa; Elaborar cartas expedidas e/ou cartas respostas a serem encaminhadas a organismos públicos;
  • Acompanhar as publicações em nome da empresa, realizadas no Diário Oficial do Município e nos Diários de Justiça (Estadual e Federal); Aperfeiçoar custos da área; Elaborar defesas e recursos administrativos; Elaborar e realizar controle das procurações da empresa; Realizar gestão dos prestadores de serviços advocatícios da área;

Position description:

Purpose

We are looking for a highly skilled and results-driven CRM Campaign Manager to join our dynamic marketing team.You will work closely with both central and regional teams to develop high-performing emails that meet our business objectives, with the number 1 focus of generating a high number of highly qualified marketing leads.

Key responsibilities:

Create and execute impactful email campaigns

  • Onboard regions onto our weekly educator email template, whilst continuing to improve it, using A/B testing and user feedback to create a highly engaging email.
  • Develop and implement strategic email marketing campaigns to ensure we deliver on business objectives.
  • Work in close collaboration with our central marketing team to ensure our email campaigns are an excellent execution of brand guidelines.

Segment, personalize and nurture

  • Take our email campaigns to the next level by segmenting the database based on audience needs and preferences.
  • Design and develop personalised email journeys for each of our segments, continually nurturing them towards booking a face-to-face meeting.
  • Implement a data ‘creep’ strategy to ensure we are slowly building a deep data set to fuel our audience insight.

Track, measure and optimize

  • Monitor campaign performance, analyse data and metrics, and provide actionable insights and recommendations for campaign optimisation at both globally and locally level.
  • Stay updated with marketing trends, technologies and best practices to drive campaign innovation.

Project and stakeholder management

  • Manage relationships with external agencies, central and local teams, as well as data, web and insight teams to ensure timely and effective campaign execution as well as continuous email performance refinement.
  • Work with multiple local teams to adapt global content to be relevant for each local market, and ensure local campaigns adhere to overall business strategy.
  • Communicate results and future improvements with key stakeholders.
  • Educate and inspire the whole global marketing on what best-in-class email marketing looks like.

Required skills and experience:

  • Proven experience in email marketing, campaign management and newsletter optimisation.
  • Experience of working in a global environment.
  • Strong understanding of email performance metrics (open rate, CTR, MQLs) and experience driving these metrics.
  • Excellent skills in A/B testing, database segmentation and personalisation strategies.
  • Knowledge of marketing automation platforms and CRM systems (ideally Salesforce and/or Braze).
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret campaign data, identify trends and provide actionable insights.
  • Exceptional writing, communication and organisational skills.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Experience of working in a global environment.
  • Creativity and strategic thinking to develop innovative email campaigns.
  • Passion for using digital marketing to make a positive impact.
  • Attention to detail and brand compliance.
  • Knowledge of data privacy laws.
  • Interest in exploring how AI could support and enhance the role.
  • Excellent communication skills in both written and spoken English.
  • Availability to attend Pearson's office in São Paulo (Barra Funda) 1 to 2 times per week.

A História da Bauducco começou há quase 70 anos, quando Carlo Bauducco, nosso fundador, chegou ao Brasil trazendo uma receita de família e o sonho de abrir seu próprio negócio.

Além de sermos a maior indústria de Wafers e Torradas das Américas.

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

A Brasif Máquinas é uma empresa consolidada no mercado, especializada na distribuição de máquinas e equipamentos de alta performance.   • Realizar atividades básicas como troca de peças, ajustes de sistemas e lubrificação.
  • Organizar e manter as ferramentas e o ambiente de trabalho limpos e funcionais.
  • Transportar peças, ferramentas e equipamentos necessários para os reparos.
  • Preencher relatórios ou auxiliar no registro das atividades realizadas.
  • Colaborar com a equipe para cumprir prazos e assegurar a qualidade dos serviços prestados.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Conhecimento básico em mecânica, elétrica ou hidráulica.

  • Habilidade para lidar com ferramentas manuais e elétricas.
  • Interesse em aprender e se desenvolver na área de manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Proatividade, organização e disposição para trabalhar em equipe.

title: Supply Chain Trainee New
description:
Job Description

Nutreco Global Supply Chain Young Professional Program

Help achieve our purpose: Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a pioneer in animal nutrition and aquafeed – and our purpose of Feeding the Future is our passion. Through it, we’re shaping a sustainable future for food production globally. As part of the SHV family, our business lines, Skretting and Trouw Nutrition , are revolutionising aquaculture and advancing livestock health and productivity with innovative solutions that are breaking new ground in the industry. There’s no better place to kickstart your career!

The opportunity

he SC YPP is designed to build well-rounded supply chain professionals who can thrive in a global business environment. You will work closely with our global supply chain leadership teams and business units and contribute to real projects that drive efficiency and innovation.

Drive your future success in end-to-end supply chain by learning from some of the industry’s foremost experts in sustainability, procurement, quality, manufacturing, logistics, planning and engineering. In 18 months, you will gain hands-on experience and rotate through different Nutreco locations.

Through structured academy weeks, mentorship, and international exposure, you will develop skills needed to take on future roles within our supply chain

What we’re looking for:

Professional experience and passion: You have completed a master’s degree and have a genuine interest in end-to-end supply chain, with the analytical and problem-solving skills to thrive in a dynamic, international environment.

Language : Good proficiency of business English and local language

Global mobility and adaptability: Must be fully internationally mobile and ready for two global rotations. Candidates must hold permanent residency with a home country passport; visa sponsorship is not available.

Proactive learners : Enjoyment in mastering complex concepts and applying learnings in practical ways to make an impact.

Creative problem solvers: Ability to approach challenges creatively, thinking outside the box to find the best solutions.

Diversity & inclusion: Appreciation and respect for diverse perspectives and ability to share your own, and work inclusively.

Collaboration & entrepreneurial mindset: value working well with others, taking initiative, thriving in a team environment & bringing an innovative, problem-solving mindset.

Work eligibility: Candidates must hold permanent residency with a home country passport; visa sponsorship is not available.

Why Nutreco?

By choosing Nutreco, you’ll help us lead the change towards global sustainable food production, equipped with the best training and mentorship and a spirit of innovation. This program isn’t just about what you can bring to us, but how we can grow together, fostering a culture that sparks entrepreneurial mindset.

Young Professional Program description

We offer a special 18-month program, split into three six-month rotations on the job, normally in three different countries, in three different supply chain areas. The program is designed to help you fully develop yourself on a personal and professional level by understanding our end-to-end supply chain processes, including the interdependencies and interconnectedness between different areas. You will gain industry-specific knowledge and leverage the experience of experts in our different locations and Opcos.

Local hiring company - home location

You will spend the first six months at your home location gaining on-the-job experience with a real-life job, learning about key supply chain processes, systems, respective goods and services and dataflows. In parallel, you will also start to develop your personal network in a collaborative environment.

Plant and Opco locations

After the first six months working from your home location, you will spend several months in some of our international plants and locations. The focus here will be on gaining additional perspectives and learning about the day-to-day operational and strategic challenges. At this point, you may identify potential improvements to help us along in our continuous drive for optimisation.

YPP Academy Weeks

Each rotation starts with a Skills Development Academy week focused on job-specific learning and personal development. You will also meet your fellow global Young Professionals and benefit from a wide range of trainings and events.

During all the phases of your traineeship, you will work as part of the Supply Chain team on a challenging position, global project, operational business tasks and attend several training courses. This combination of on-the-job, projects, training and international experience will provide you with excellent skills and give you a solid head start on your career.

Step into your future

Recruitment process

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.
  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.
  • Conhecimento de Produtos: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos disponíveis na farmácia, incluindo suas características, benefícios e possíveis interações medicamentosas.
  • Atendimento Telefônico: Atender chamadas telefônicas de forma profissional, responder a perguntas dos clientes.
  • Organização: Manter a área de atendimento ao cliente e as prateleiras organizadas. Garantir que produtos perigosos sejam armazenados adequadamente e de acordo com as normas de segurança.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

  • Iniciativa e Proatividade: Tendência a agir sem necessidade de supervisão constante, antecipando problemas ou necessidades e tomando ações para resolvê-los ou atendê-las.
  • Postura Profissional: Manutenção de uma conduta ética, aparência pessoal adequada e atitude sempre respeitosa e positiva no ambiente de trabalho.
  • Capacidade de Lidar sob Pressão: Habilidade para manter o desempenho e o bom humor em situações desafiadoras, como picos de atendimento ou reclamações de clientes.
  • Zelo por Padrões: Compromisso em seguir rigorosamente as normas de higiene, segurança e os procedimentos operacionais da empresa.

Por que vagas preferenciais para mulheres?

A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Além disso, acreditamos que o avanço em equidade de gênero contribui para a construção de um futuro melhor para todos. Queremos aumentar a representatividade de todas as mulheres: pretas, brancas, com qualquer identidade de gênero e orientação sexual ou que tenham algum tipo de deficiência.

Entendemos que iniciativas com foco em vagas preferenciais contribuem para avanços na criação de um ambiente cada vez mais colaborativo, inovador e atrativo para novos talentos. Por isso, valorizamos em diferentes ações e processos seletivos a participação de todos os diferentes perfis de candidatos e candidatas, nas diferentes dimensões de grupos que integram a agenda de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

O processo seletivo para esta posição segue o mesmo formato, etapas e formas de avaliação de outros programas de recrutamento da Vale.

Juntos, a gente transforma o futuro.

A Vale tem uma história de transformação. Na mineração, atuamos para transformar recursos naturais em prosperidade e desenvolvimento sustentável. Na segurança, buscamos aprender com o passado para evoluir diariamente e se tornar referência de confiabilidade.

Nossas pessoas fazem parte de toda esta jornada de transformação e evolução. Afinal, o nosso compromisso é com a vida. A Vale existe para melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro. Juntos.

Acreditamos que a mineração é essencial para o desenvolvimento do mundo e precisamos deixar um legado para o meio ambiente, para as comunidades em que estamos e para todas as vidas que tocamos.

Nos orgulhamos de empregar mais de 120 mil pessoas, em 30 países. Somente com esta força, nos tornamos a maior mineradora do mundo em minério de ferro, pelotas e níquel. Também atuamos nas áreas de logística, energia e siderurgia.

  • Elaborar relatórios e análises de melhoria contínua;

  • Comunicação eficiente e foco em resultado;

  • Experiência com processos de melhoria contínua.

Como é trabalhar na Vale?

Para transformar o futuro temos de cuidar do presente. Apostamos em um ambiente cada vez mais aberto, em que as pessoas possam ser mais autônomas e buscar o seu desenvolvimento pessoal.

Criamos para os nossos colaboradores um portfólio de treinamentos e capacitações técnicas, de gestão e de liderança ou transversais. Acreditamos em quem faz a nossa empresa.

Solicitamos aos trabalhadores que se vacinem contra a COVID-19 e que apresentem o cartão de vacinação com os dados do imunizante, ou carteira de vacinação digital gerada pelo Conecte SUS.

Buscamos um Analista de CRM Pleno para otimizar campanhas, desenvolver estratégias data-driven e garantir a melhor experiência para nossos leads e clientes. O setor está em constante evolução e exige profissionais que saibam trabalhar com dados e tecnologia para impulsionar a performance.

  • Criar, segmentar e otimizar campanhas de CRM utilizando HubSpot, Sendgrid, Databricks e outras ferramentas.

  • Estruturar e automatizar réguas de comunicação via e-mail, WhatsApp (HSM), SMS e push notifications.
  • Implementar e analisar testes A/B para otimização de mensagens e fluxos automatizados.

  • SQL avançado para manipulação de bases de dados, segmentação e análise de público.

  • Conhecimento em HSM (WhatsApp Business API) e estratégias de mensagens para conversão.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar métricas e propor soluções baseadas em dados.

  • Conhecimento em Python para automação de processos e análise de dados.

description:
Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.
We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single-tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.

Summary

The Operations team at Latitude.sh is responsible for ensuring the seamless functioning of our global infrastructure. While provisioning new servers and IT infrastructure is essential, our mission is to maintain high availability, ensure rapid response times, and deliver exceptional service quality to our clients.

We are seeking a Senior Operations Analyst to join our team, working on the second (01:00 PM to 10:00 PM) or third shift (10:00 PM to 07:00 AM). This role requires hands-on technical skills, strong ownership of tasks, and the ability to lead and support critical operational processes across multiple data center environments.

Key Responsabilities

  • Lead the execution and coordination of operational tasks involving infrastructure services – including servers, storage, networking equipment, and platform software;
  • Perform and oversee rack and stack activities, hardware installation, and in-cabinet maintenance;
  • Manage relationships and workflows with remote data center techs, ensuring adherence to operational standards and procedures;
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows operating systems;
  • Conduct root cause analysis and handle complex issues related to hardware failures, RAID rebuilds, storage allocation, and disk lifecycle management;
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot out-of-band management platforms such as IPMI/BMC;
  • Support and improve internal operational documentation, workflows, and escalation procedures;
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (B2 or higher);
  • Proven experience with server hardware, including diagnostics, replacements, and upgrades;
  • Strong understanding of data center standards, rack layouts, cabling, power distribution (PDU), and remote hands coordination;
  • Proficiency with monitoring platforms, ticketing systems, and incident handling workflows;
  • Solid knowledge of Linux system administration (CentOS, Ubuntu, or similar), including command line operations, scripting, and performance tuning;
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server environments;
  • Familiarity with RAID technologies, disk provisioning, and troubleshooting storage systems;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or similar working experience;
  • Prior experience in a senior role within a data center operations or infrastructure support team is a strong plus.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive Compensation;
  • Annual Bonus based on company and team performance;
  • Work Anniversary bonus;
  • Transportation or fuel voucher (without discounts);
  • Subsidies for education, certification and English courses;
  • Partnership with SESC extended to dependents.

Why Latitude.sh?

We're a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem-solving. As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.

Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.

description:
Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems

Join to apply for the Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems role at Canonical

Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems

6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical
As a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business, this role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.
You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs region.
The role entails

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects
What we are looking for in you
  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre o PicPay

Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender às necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia. Fundada em Vitória (ES), a empresa já conta com mais de 35 milhões de clientes ativos e faz parte do grupo J&F, um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do Brasil. A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop.

Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.

O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.

Nossa unidade de negócio de Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física é responsável pelo ecossistema que vai desde carteira digital, PIX, PicPay Card, até a contratação de empréstimos. Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today. We aim to increase the representation of Black individuals in technology through effective hiring policies and the development of our leadership for their professional and personal growth.

Role Responsibilities

About the Role:

This talent bank is exclusively for LGBTQIAPN+ individuals, as we understand that embracing diversity is a social responsibility, allowing us to create an increasingly inclusive and respectful environment for all. Our internal team will review your application and direct it to the most relevant area. We want to get to know you better and explore possible opportunities, so please apply for this and any other opportunity that aligns with your experience on our careers page.

Here, you will also find 99Afro, our affinity group that, along with HR and our leadership, addresses this agenda and action plans to achieve greater racial representation, both in entry-level and leadership positions, creating an inclusive environment where individuals feel a sense of belonging and empowerment.

Additionally, you will have the opportunity to participate in activities of other groups, such as 99Colors (leading LGBTQIAP+ issues), 99Adapta (issues concerning people with disabilities), 99Women (gender issues), and 99Families (parenting issues).

Role Qualifications

-

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.

  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Women, and 99Families.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come. We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant individuals and people with disabilities (PwD).

description:
Description

In this role you will be responsible for aggressively developing and managing an active pipeline through seeking out prospects, calling on potential clients, conducting in-depth needs analysis/risk assessments, developing ideas for meeting their needs, presenting information on the organization’s capabilities, strategically cross-selling products aligned with clients’ needs and introducing technical specialists, as required, to win and retain the business.

The Role

Most of the activity in this role is directed toward the generation of new sales to existing and prospective clients. Success in this role is based on the incumbent’s ability to win and retain new business and meet or exceed established sales goal targets related to revenue growth, mix of business and penetration into industry-specific targets.

Performance Objectives:

Achievement of Stated Sales Goals

Sales Process:

  • Prepare proposals and presentations using marketing resources, practice groups and other Willis Towers Watson producers.
  • Design individual prospect sales strategies and develop unique prospect programs.
  • Align with individual client sales strategies.
  • Conduct thorough needs analysis/risk assessment to uncover prospects/clients’ unique coverage needs.
  • Provide consultative advice in key risk areas.
  • Identify and close potential cross-sell opportunities.

Client Management:

  • Maintain consistent/high-quality touch points by phone and face-to-face with clients.
  • Champion the proper advocacy of claims.
  • Participate in stewardship meetings.
  • Support Client Management team in identifying and closing rounding opportunities.

Pipeline Management:

  • Identify prospects for business from existing and prospective clients.
  • Develop new relationships with individuals responsible for insurance and risk management decisions.
  • Obtain referral leads from existing clients.
  • Aggressively identify and pursue cross-selling opportunities.
  • Participate and take leadership roles in targeted community and professional associations.

People Management:

  • Provide annual input for the performance review of team members.
  • Provide timely/quality feedback to service team members; assist team members in acquiring new skills.
  • Help to identify and develop future producer talent.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • BA/BS degree in related field of study required. Advanced education degrees preferred.
  • Valid State-relevant Insurance license(s).
  • 3 years’ experience in insurance sales.
  • Professional designations such as CPCU, ARM, CIC preferred.
  • Proven track record of successful pipeline development, delivery of effective sales strategies and reputation as a client-centric sales professional.
  • Comprehensive working knowledge of principles and methods of selling products; services and value propositions; sales marketing strategies and tactics; technical knowledge of insurance and risk management products, services, and value propositions; pipeline management & cross-selling.
  • Ability to identify and leverage essential information and think in a critical and logical manner.
  • Ability to work in a client-centric strategic and decisive manner according to tight deadlines.
  • Excellent communication (written, verbal & oral) skills and interpersonal skills.

EOE, including disability/vets.

NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA.
Na Natura, temos potencial para impulsionar transformações significativas. Isso é possível por meio dos produtos inovadores da Natura e Avon; das experiências marcantes dos serviços de beleza da Bluma; da nossa plataforma de educação financeira, a Emana Pay, e grande parte das franquias da The Body Shop na América Latina. O que você vai fazer por aqui?
Responsável pela apuração financeira da área de Logística e pela gestão de iniciativas de performance em Intralogística e Transportes, atuando em uma equipe comprometida com eficiência e resultados. Foco na análise de custos, desenvolvimento de KPIs, melhoria contínua e gestão de projetos estratégicos, com forte ênfase em dados e liderança colaborativa.

Quais conhecimentos e vivências você vai precisar para compartilhar com a nossa rede?

  • Atuar como ponte entre as áreas de Logística, Planejamento e Financeiro, garantindo a integração e a comunicação eficaz;
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de custos operacionais, planejamento orçamentário e identificação de oportunidades de otimização;
  • Desenvolver e implementar indicadores de performance (KPIs) para monitorar a performance operacional de operações logísticas e sua conversão em resultados;
  • Criar e monitorar reports de desempenho financeiro sobre despesas logísticas (armazenagem e distribuição);
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de controle e redução de custos logísticos, garantindo a eficiência nas operações;
  • Controlar as faturas e contratos de serviços logísticos, identificando oportunidades de negociação e redução de custos;
  • Criar e elaborar lógica de conexão de drivers de performance com custos logísticos;
  • Liderar iniciativas em Squads de Performance (novos modelos de contratação, programas de incentivo de performance operacional, entre outros) que garantam a eficiência operacional;
  • Identificar tendências de mercado e propor soluções inovadoras para os desafios logísticos e financeiros.

Quais os Requisitos?
Experiência com Supply Planning ou com Finanças;
Conhecimento avançado em Excel/Sheets;
Conhecimento em Python / SQL é diferencial.

O que você vai encontrar por aqui?
Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.

O Eletricista é responsável por executar a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de sistemas elétricos, garantindo o pleno funcionamento das instalações e a segurança dos ambientes. Este profissional desempenha um papel crucial na manutenção e operação eficiente dos equipamentos e sistemas da empresa.

  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas para se manter informado sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de manutenção.
  • Responder a chamadas de emergência e realizar reparos urgentes para minimizar o tempo de inatividade e garantir a continuidade das operações.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo ou técnico na área de elétrica ou áreas relacionadas.

Venha fazer a diferença no maior banco privado da América Latina. Somos a instituição financeira feita com milhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo e acreditamos que a diversidade dos nossos times é fundamental para que possamos construir soluções inovadoras e adequadas para cada um dos nossos clientes. Por isso, estamos em busca de talentos para integrar nosso quadro de itubers (colaboradores do Itaú).

Conheça as estruturas que compõem o Atacado:

Itaú BBA é o maior Corporate & Investment Bank da América Latina. Atendemos investidores institucionais e empresas com faturamento anual acima de R$ 30 milhões. Pela complexidade dos negócios desses clientes, sabemos que nossa atuação deve ser customizada. Temos um portfólio de investimentos em ativos, assessoria em fusões e aquisições, oferta de ações, securitização, derivativos, operações estruturadas, cash management, financiamentos e garantias, entre outros. São soluções desenhadas por uma equipe de especialistas com base no perfil e necessidades de cada empresa.

Em Wealth Management and Services somos responsáveis pela jornada de investimentos dos nossos clientes, olhando desde a gestão de recursos próprios ou de terceiros em Asset Management, Fund of Funds e Kinea, passando pela estruturação e evolução dos nossos produtos e serviços, até o relacionamento com nossos clientes, sejam eles pessoas físicas de alta renda no Private Bank e na assessoria de investimentos Íon, ou clientes institucionais.

A área de Global Markets & Treasury é responsável pela conexão dos nossos clientes com o mercado, viabilizando o acesso deles aos produtos financeiros. Temos a missão de garantir uma oferta competitiva, inovadora e focada nas necessidades das empresas, cultivando o foco na excelência de atendimento e encantamento dos nossos clientes para gerar resultados.


O que estamos buscando:

Estamos buscando por pessoas que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.

Como um futuro Ituber, é importante que você seja colaborativo (aqui a gente vai de turma!) para construir soluções e proporcionar melhoria contínua na jornada dos nossos produtos. Temos oportunidades em diversas áreas do banco de Atacado e precisamos do seu talento para contribuir com a transformação que buscamos.


Com quais benefícios vou poder contar?

  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale Alimentação (Supermercados)
  • Convênio médico e odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • PLR (Mediante resultados do banco)
  • Previdência privada
  • Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros
  • Licença maternidade estendida
  • Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)
  • Incentivo a estudos
  • Gym Pass (Mas se preferir temos Bio Ritmo em alguns polos)
  • Acesso aos Clubes Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)
  • + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo

O Itaú estimula candidaturas de pessoas com deficiência em todas as nossas posições, sendo assim, sinta-se à vontade para se candidatar em vagas sinalizadas como exclusivas ou não para pessoas com deficiência. Somos comprometidos com a inclusão e valorizamos a diversidade.

  • Domínio de informática é imprescindível;

Informações adicionais

Na Vivo, apoiamos e valorizamos nossos colaboradores com benefícios flexíveis e exclusivos, incluindo descontos, plano móvel gratuito após 3 meses, benefícios personalizados, auxílio educação, programas de desenvolvimento e remuneração variável.

Somos uma empresa do Grupo Telefônica, líder em telecomunicações no Brasil, com o propósito de Digitalizar para Aproximar . Valorizamos diversidade, inovação e uma cultura inclusiva, buscando transformar a experiência de nossos clientes e colaboradores por meio da tecnologia e da inovação.

description:
HRS AS A COMPANY

HRS is reinventing the way businesses work, stay, and pay in today’s dynamic global marketplace. Its advanced Lodging as a Service platform (ProcureTech, FinTech, TravelTech) extends beyond transient lodging to meetings, office space management, workforce accommodations, and global payment efficiency.

Beyond cost optimization, HRS focuses on safety, security, sustainability, and satisfaction. It is recognized for its Green Stay Initiative, supporting corporate hotel programs in achieving NetZero targets.

Founded in 1972, HRS collaborates with 35% of the Fortune 500, leading hotel chains, regional hospitality groups, and payment providers.

Our international organization ensures high standards of consulting, delivery, and operations, supported by global methodologies and data-driven quarterly reviews.

The Brazil Hotel Account Manager (all genders) manages performance of regional hotel chains and participates in international accommodation programs for prestigious corporate clients.   • Design and implement strategic initiatives, coordinating with internal teams across regions.
  • Act as the main contact for hotel partners, supported by operational and solution teams.
  • Contribute to HRS’s growth across all Lodging as a Service platforms, acting entrepreneurially within the organization.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Experience in a tech-focused enterprise (e.g., SaaS, TravelTech).
  • Business acumen in supply organization dynamics.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Solution selling capability and experience with complex value propositions.
  • Ability to build senior stakeholder networks.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional projects.
  • Data analysis and strategic insight extraction skills.
  • Passion for travel tech and digital platforms.
  • Deep understanding of HRS’s business model and solutions.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
PERSPECTIVE AND LOCATION

Join a global network of intrapreneurs dedicated to transforming the travel industry. Our environment promotes ownership, continuous learning, and sustainability. The position offers competitive remuneration, work equipment, mobility, and variable incentives.

Job Summary
Langan is seeking a Wastewater Practice Leader to join its collaborative national team. This individual will serve a key function in leading and supporting design and permitting efforts for a variety of wastewater distribution systems, wastewater treatment facilities, pump stations and wastewater master plans. In this role, you will have the opportunity to partner with top industry leadership in fueling the growth of a multi-disciplinary practice.

  • Lead and motivate a team to achieve goals and objectives;
  • Drive Business Development activities by developing new clients for the firm and maintaining relationships with existing clients;
  • Integrate Langan's multi-disciplinary services including geotechnical and environmental engineering into all aspects of land development projects; and
  • Performing other duties as requested.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering required;
  • Possess a valid Professional Engineer license;
  • Possess 10+ years of related civil engineering experience with a concentration in wastewater distribution systems, pump station design and wastewater treatment plant design on both small and large projects;
  • Strong client development and client management abilities;
  • Expertise in wastewater design, hydraulic analysis and design;
  • Experience in technical and proposal writing. Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical and judgment capabilities;
  • Understanding of AutoCAD or Civil 3D;
  • Active participation in professional organizations;
  • Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment, and to mentor staff engineers;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, multitasking, and judgment capabilities; and
  • Possess reliable transportation for client meetings and job site visits and a valid driver’s license in good standing.

Langan provides a rich array of programs and benefits to help its employees advance their careers and enhance the quality of their lives. Our comprehensive compensation package includes: full-time employment company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and paid pregnancy disability leave; 401(k)/Roth with company match; paid time off including parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses; and educational reimbursement.
Langan offers employee resource groups; flexible work schedules; extensive training; wellness programs; buddy and mentoring programs; and much more!
Langan is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We believe that an inclusive workplace is essential for the well-being and success of our employees.

title: Gastheer / Gastvrouw - De Wilgenborgh Rotterdam
description:
Met jouw gevoel voor sfeer en hart voor mensen zorg jij ervoor dat De Wilgenborgh een warme, verzorgde en uitnodigende plek is. Als gastheer of gastvrouw ben jij onmisbaar in het creëren van een prettige sfeer en een hygiënische omgeving in het gebouw. Op deze dynamische en grote locatie wonen jonge moeders en kwetsbare meiden en jouw inzet draagt bij aan een veilige en gastvrije omgeving waar zij rustig kunnen wonen en zich gezien voelen.
De basis schoonmaaktaken zoals stofzuigen, dweilen en toiletten reinigen worden uitgevoerd door een schoonmaakbedrijf. We stimuleren mensen met een achterstand op de arbeidsmarkt om ook op deze vacature te reageren.

Wat ga je doen?

Als gastheer of gastvrouw zorg jij ervoor dat het gebouw — van de kantoren tot de huiskamers en algemene ruimtes — een nette, verzorgde en gastvrije uitstraling heeft. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden van de sfeer en praktische zaken binnen het pand. Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:

  • Boodschappen doen en het aanvullen van voorraden;
  • Gastvrije ontvangst van bezoekers op de locatie;
  • Planten verzorgen en het nalopen van gezamenlijke ruimten;
  • Lichte huishoudelijke taken, zoals het reinigen van koelkasten of een oven;
  • Het doen van de was en zorgen voor schone doekjes en materialen op de kantoren;
  • Het bijhouden en bestellen van benodigdheden;
  • Post sorteren;
  • Signaleren wat er nodig is op de locatie en hier zelfstandig op handelen;
  • Zorg dragen voor de algemene ruimtes zodat het gebouw er netjes en welkom uitziet — ook bij binnenkomst;
  • Een laagdrempelig aanspreekpunt zijn voor bewoners en collega’s;
  • Tot slot vinden we het leuk als je lekkere koffie kunt zetten.

Wie ben jij?

Je vindt het belangrijk dat mensen zich welkom voelen in een verzorgde omgeving. Jij past bij ons als je:

  • Oog hebt voor sfeer, hygiëne en wat er nodig is in een veilige en prettige woon- en werkomgeving;
  • Zelfstandig en zorgvuldig werkt;
  • Sociaal en benaderbaar bent in het contact met anderen;
  • Stressbestendig bent;
  • Flexibel inzetbaar bent — je werktijden worden in overleg bepaald en kunnen over meerdere dagen verdeeld worden;
  • Onze christelijke levensovertuiging deelt;
  • Affiniteit hebt met jongeren en/of een zorgomgeving.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Timon werk je in een betekenisvolle omgeving waar jouw inzet direct zichtbaar effect heeft. Jij krijgt:

  • Een contract voor 8 uur per week, met werktijden in overleg en flexibel in te delen;
  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg, schaal 4 op basis van 36 uur per week, van € 2.454,54 tot maximaal € 3.216,05.
  • 25 vakantiedagen (naar rato), 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Een betrokken team om mee samen te werken en ruimte om de functie op jouw manier in te vullen.

Over je werkplek

De Wilgenborgh in Rotterdam is een grote, levendige woon- en werklocatie voor jonge moeders en kwetsbare jonge vrouwen. Naast woningen vind je hier diverse kantoren, gezamenlijke huiskamers en algemene ruimten waar dagelijks begeleiding en ondersteuning plaatsvindt. Jij draagt zorg voor een verzorgde en uitnodigende uitstraling van het hele gebouw — van de voordeur tot de vergaderruimtes. Jouw aanwezigheid maakt de locatie vriendelijk, schoon en overzichtelijk voor bewoners, bezoekers én collega’s.

Over Timon

Timon is een christelijke organisatie voor jeugdzorg, hulpverlening en ondersteuning van gezinnen. Met ruim 800 collega’s zetten we ons in voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders in heel Nederland. Onze kracht? Persoonlijke betrokkenheid, professioneel vakmanschap en een hart voor hoopvolle toekomstperspectieven.

Meer weten over hoe we omgaan met onze christelijke identiteit? Kijk op .

Enthousiast? Solliciteer!

Ben jij de gastheer of gastvrouw die sfeer en structuur brengt op De Wilgenborgh? Solliciteer dan via onze website. Vragen over de inhoud van deze functie? Neem contact op met Joske Vos, teammanager op 06-38778054 . Heb je vragen over de selectieprocedure, dan kan je contact opnemen met onze recruiter Kitty Bernardus.

title: Contract Specialist
description:
Job Summary

Join Medpace at our Sao Paulo office! Our clinical operations activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, Contract Specialist to join our LatAm Site Contract Team within the Clinical Operations team. This position will report to the LatAm Senior Contract Manager and will play a key role in the study start-up and clinical trial management processes at Medpace. The Contract Specialist will play a key role in advancing the start-up of our projects. If you want an exciting career where you use your previous expertise and can develop and grow your career even further, then this is the opportunity for you.

Responsibilities

  1. Is responsible for preparing, negotiating, tracking and finalizing the Confidentiality Agreements (CDA), Clinical Trial Agreements (CTA), Budgets and Letters of Indemnification (LOI) as well as Amendments to these documents, as needed.
  2. Manages all required contractual agreements with investigator sites, including distribution, negotiation of budget and language, tracking and finalization.
  3. Proactively identifies site contract related risks and potential roadblocks.
  4. Prepares contract approval timelines with investigators and leads efforts to obtain contract approval to meet study deliverables.
  5. Maintains communication with project team and sites regarding status of all contractual requirements.
  6. Collaborates with the project team to ensure the client deliverables and expectations are achieved.
  7. Liaises with internal customers to review contract or budget areas that impact final execution of site contracts.
  8. Maintains tracking regarding site contracts and provides regular updates as agreed by the study team to the project team and client regarding status and efforts to ensure timelines are maintained.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree in business administration, legal studies, or life sciences.
  2. Ability to work with internal and external customers/vendors to meet project-specific goals.
  3. Ability to manage high volume work and meet rigorous deadlines.
  4. Flexibility to strategically manage negotiations with minimal oversight.
  5. Ability to interact with site and other functional areas as secondary project contact for contracting issues and questions.
  6. Ability to manage time and project requirements based on study deliverables.
  7. CRO experience or investigator site experience negotiating site agreements preferred.
  8. Fluency in English. Portuguese desirable.

***We kindly ask to send applications in English & salary expectation in BRL***

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

People. Purpose. Passion. Make a Difference Tomorrow. Join Us Today.

The work we’ve done over the past 30+ years has positively impacted the lives of countless patients and families who face hundreds of diseases across all key therapeutic areas. The work we do today will improve the lives of people living with illness and disease in the future.

Medpace Perks

  • Flexible work environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package
  • Competitive PTO packages
  • Structured career paths with opportunities for professional growth
  • Company-sponsored employee appreciation events
  • Employee health and wellness initiatives

Awards

  • Recognized by Forbes as one of America's Most Successful Midsize Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024
  • Continually recognized with CRO Leadership Awards from Life Science Leader magazine based on expertise, quality, capabilities, reliability, and compatibility

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your qualifications and, if interested, you will be contacted with details for next steps.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).
Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.
Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

Conheça nossa história

Fundada em 1997, a Mar Brasil se destaca pela gestão orientada por OKRs e NCTs. Nossa missão é fornecer soluções sustentáveis, inovadoras e disruptivas em serviços e locações no Estado de São Paulo, com expansão contínua para outros estados do Brasil.

Nosso compromisso é garantir a máxima qualidade do ar e o conforto térmico para todos. Atuamos principalmente no mercado B2G (Business to Government) em todo o Brasil.

Nosso objetivo de longo prazo é promover a climatização com autossuficiência energética em todas as escolas públicas do Brasil, contribuindo para um ambiente de aprendizado mais saudável e eficiente.

Cultura Forte

  • Respeito e Oportunidade : Através da Academia Mar Brasil, preparamos e treinamos nossos colaboradores, oferecendo oportunidades e reconhecendo o esforço dos bons e dos extraordinários.
  • Ética : Nossas relações são fundamentadas na verdade, integridade, honestidade, transparência, justiça e no bem ao próximo.
  • Liberdade de Expressão e Movimento : Valorizamos a simplicidade em nossas relações e processos, respeitando e ouvindo todas as opiniões, independentemente da posição na empresa.
  • Inovação e Ousadia : Aplicamos e incentivamos o pensamento inovador, com criatividade, processos tecnológicos e ideias disruptivas.
  • Propósito de Pertencimento : Comprometemo-nos profundamente com nossa missão e nossos valores.
  • Contribuição com a Sociedade : Oferecemos um serviço público de qualidade, promovendo a melhoria da educação por meio do conforto térmico e da qualidade do ar para alunos e professores.

Venha ser um Prestador Credenciado na Mar Brasil!

Como prestador credenciado na Mar Brasil, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir para nossa missão de garantir a máxima qualidade do ar para alunos e professores nas escolas públicas de todo o Brasil. Na Mar Brasil, não apenas realizamos a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de ar-condicionado, mas também proporcionamos qualidade de vida em diversas unidades de ensino espalhadas pelo país.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Instalação, Manutenção Preventiva e Corretiva : Verificação geral do funcionamento dos aparelhos, limpeza de componentes e substituição de peças conforme necessário.
  • Procedimentos Técnicos : Aplicação das melhores práticas no manuseio de fluidos refrigerantes e lubrificantes, e realização de interligações elétricas de acordo com a legislação ambiental vigente.
  • Utilização de Instrumentos : Medição de componentes com termômetros, conjunto manifold e alicate amperímetro, técnicas de flange e outros equipamentos necessários.

O que Procuramos:

  • Profissionais com profundo conhecimento em potência e ciclo frigorífico.
  • Experiência comprovada em testes de componentes e acessórios.
  • Habilidade com ferramentas e equipamentos especializados.
  • Capacidade de uso de aplicativos digitais em celular.
  • Competência em trabalho colaborativo, organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Certificação comprovada, veículo próprio, ferramental adequado e EPIs.
  • Empresa com CNPJ ativo e experiência comprovada.

O que Oferecemos:

  • Contrato Estável : Oferecemos contratos de longa duração, garantindo estabilidade durante todas as estações do ano, tanto no inverno quanto no verão.
  • Política de Incentivo : Após o período de integração, o prestador pode contar com o financiamento de equipamentos, ferramentas e veículos.
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Dinâmico : Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional em atividades B2G, B2B e B2C.
  • Bônus e Premiação Extraordinária : Prestadores que cumprirem com suas obrigações contratuais, metas qualitativas e quantitativas, e demais políticas da empresa, poderão se qualificar para o programa de bonificação por produtividade e resultados.

Se você está pronto para se unir a uma empresa que valoriza a excelência e busca sempre as melhores soluções para seus clientes, esta é a sua chance. Junte-se a nós na Mar Brasil!

description:
Join to apply for the Research Coordinator role at Interpret

Join to apply for the Research Coordinator role at Interpret

This range is provided by Interpret. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

R$96,000.00/yr - R$120,000.00/yr

Interpret is a global media, entertainment, and technology insights agency. We work with the biggest brands in entertainment and technology, across video games, movies and television, consumer electronics, social media, and advertising. While headquartered in Los Angeles, our team spans the globe. We have offices in Dallas, San Francisco, London, Munich, Shanghai, and Seoul, and a network of strong local partners around the world. We are specialists in global consumer insight, with the majority of our engagements involving multiple markets and languages. For more information, visit Role
Role Location: Hybrid (Brazil)
Role Overview
We are seeking a Research Coordinator to manage and expand our Good Gamer Group (GGG) community in Brazil. This role involves recruiting participants, ensuring they meet research qualifications, and coordinating with them to ensure successful attendance at studies. This position will work closely with the USA team on a similar schedule, facilitating live, synchronous communication with participants. You will also have responsibilities for managing participant recruitment and engagement for both Brazil and the USA.
This is a full-time role requiring approximately 40 hours per week, with occasional weekend work offset by weekday adjustments. The role includes a company-provided cell phone plan to facilitate seamless communication with participants.
Key Responsibilities
Community Growth & Engagement:

  • Build and manage the Good Gamer Group in Brazil, fostering authenticity and trust.
  • Handle all recruiting and participant communication for Brazil and assist with USA recruitment as needed.
  • Organize and confirm participant attendance, ensuring they are at the right place, at the right time, and fully prepared.
Participant Recruitment & Support
  • Identify, screen, and recruit qualified participants for studies, ensuring they meet research requirements.
  • Manage participant inquiries and provide support through phone, messaging, or email.
  • Review participant videos and open-ended responses to confirm qualifications and maintain quality standards.
  • Send out study incentives post-completion.
Translation & Localization
  • Use translation tools and partners to localize surveys and screeners for the Brazilian audience.
  • Ensure translations maintain cultural and linguistic accuracy.
Live Communication & Coordination
  • Serve as the main point of contact for Brazilian participants, organizing schedules and resolving any issues in real time.
  • Act as a live liaison between the USA team and participants to address logistical needs.
Marketing & Campaign Management
  • Plan and execute online advertising and social media campaigns to recruit gamers in Brazil.
  • Collaborate with the USA team to support recruitment efforts for both Brazil and the USA.
Ideal Profile
Skills & Qualifications
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Comfortable with live, synchronous participant interactions via phone, messaging, and virtual platforms (e.g., Zoom).
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian gaming industry and communities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other basic productivity tools.
  • Self-motivated team player with a passion for gaming.
  • Willingness to travel to Sao Paulo for occasional on-site testing.
What's on Offer?
  • Join one of the leading Market Research firms in gaming research and help us connect with amazing gamers in Brazil!

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Company

Lift Ventures, a remote-first startup studio whose portfolio of businesses has reached over 250 million consumers to date, is seeking a seasoned and talented Data Engineer for SuperSummary, our fast-growing EdTech business. SuperSummary is a subscription-based website and mobile app offering a library of professionally written study guides and other educational tools and resources on thousands of books for students, teachers, and readers of all types.

About the Job

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our fully remote team and play a key role in designing, building, and optimizing our data systems. Reporting to the Data Engineering Coordinator, you will collaborate with product managers, department leaders, data scientists, and analysts to deliver high-quality, actionable data insights that shape product development, drive innovation, and support strategic decision-making across the company.

This position is 100% remote, with a preference for candidates based in Latin America. Our distributed team spans the U.S., Brazil, the Philippines, and beyond — we value diverse perspectives and an inclusive, collaborative work environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Develop Scalable Data Pipelines

  • Build, maintain, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, or Synapse Analytics.

  • Ensure pipelines meet business requirements, are scalable, efficient, and well-documented.

Data Integration and Management

  • Integrate data from diverse sources, including APIs, data warehouses, cloud services, and more.

  • Manage and optimize data storage solutions like Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Database, and Azure Blob Storage.

Ensure Data Quality and Governance

  • Implement data quality monitoring systems and checks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability.

  • Uphold data governance policies and ensure compliance with data security and privacy standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to understand evolving data needs and translate them into scalable solutions.

  • Provide technical support for data-related issues and contribute to the continuous improvement of the data infrastructure.

Performance Optimization

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance the performance and availability of data pipelines.

  • Optimize data workflows to improve speed, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.

Documentation and Best Practices

  • Document data architectures, workflows, and processes to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing.

  • Advocate for and apply best practices in data engineering, staying current with emerging tools and technologies.

Sample Projects

  • Unified Traffic & Session Pipelines

Built scalable ETL/ELT workflows (Airflow/Databricks) that merged clickstream and session data from Amplitude, Google Analytics, AWR, etc., into a central analytics layer—powering cross-platform marketing + product dashboards.

  • External Data Ingestion & Enrichment

Developed Python-based scrapers and API orchestrations to pull competitive pricing, book metadata, and review data—fusing it into our recommendation engine for richer decision-making.

  • Data Lakehouse & Warehouse Architecture

Led rollout of a cloud-native Lakehouse (Delta on Databricks/Azure Synapse) alongside a star-schema enterprise warehouse—standardizing schemas, partitioning strategies, and CI/CD for SQL artifacts (dbt or Synapse pipelines).

  • Data Governance & Quality Framework

Established data ownership models, automated lineage tracking, and built monitoring jobs (Great Expectations) to catch schema drift, null spikes, and stale datasets before they hit BI tools.

  • Database Performance & Cost Optimization

Tuned Postgres/Azure SQL/MySQL clusters (indexing, query refactoring, partitioning), slashed query runt.


Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of experience in data engineering, with a strong foundation in Python and SQL for building, optimizing, and maintaining data pipelines, transformations, and data-driven solutions.
